mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.name AS project_name, v.release_label AS version_label FROM requirements r LEFT JOIN api_projects p ON p.code = r.project_code LEFT JOIN release_version_archives v ON v.id = r.version_id WHERE r.requirement_no = #{requirementNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO requirements (requirement_no, title, project_code, version_id, source_branch, status, owner, note) VALUES (#{requirementNo}, #{title}, #{projectCode}, #{versionId}, #{sourceBranch}, #{status}, #{owner}, #{note})
mapper.update: UPDATE requirements SET title = #{title}, project_code = #{projectCode}, version_id = #{versionId}, source_branch = #{sourceBranch}, status = #{status}, owner = #{owner}, note = #{note} WHERE requirement_no = #{requirementNo}
UPDATE requirements SET status = 'DONE', merged_at = NOW(), source_branch = COALESCE(NULLIF(#{sourceBranch}, ''), source_branch) WHERE requirement_no = #{requirementNo}
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM requirement_modules rm JOIN project_modules m ON m.id = rm.module_id WHERE rm.requirement_no = #{requirementNo} ORDER BY m.category ASC, m.sort_order ASC, m.name ASC
